The '''Imperial Embassy''' on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] was owned by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the Empire.
